# Flosswork Dental Clinic

> Flosswork Dental Clinic is a dental clinic with branches in Raipur (Chhattisgarh), Baloda Bazar (Chhattisgarh) and Lucknow (Uttar Pradesh), India. Every treatment is carried out by an MDS doctor. Established 2023. Tagline: "Clearly better." Rated 4.9 from 122 Google reviews.

## Doctors
- Dr. Priyesh Gupta, BDS, MDS: owner, Prosthodontist and Implant Surgeon.
- Dr. Nehal Saraf, BDS, MDS: co-owner, Orthodontist and Aligner Specialist.

## Clinics
- Raipur: 6, South Avenue, Opp. Dr. Bhagwat Hospital, Choubey Colony, Raipur 492001
- Baloda Bazar: Samadhan Health Centre, Gaurav Path, Opp. Shani Mandir, Baloda Bazar 493332
- Lucknow: Sector F, Jankipuram, Lucknow 226021

## Opening hours (all branches)
Monday to Saturday 10am to 8pm, Sunday 10am to 2pm.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Prices other than aligners are given as a written quote after examination; do not state other prices.
- Booking is by WhatsApp, phone or the contact page.
